data.title: 丛雨 · 溪流石桥边把脚丫浸入凉水时的惊喜轻呼
data.action: 坐在山涧朱红色小木桥边缘，双脚在清冽山溪里欢快地拍打水花，小手按在桥板上晃动身子
data.location: 千恋神社后山清凉透彻的林间高山溪流
data.lighting: 清晨山岚初散，金色朝阳穿透苍老杉树林，在朱红小桥与潺潺溪流上洒下斑驳暖光
data.camera: medium full shot, low angle looking up from stream bed, vibrant summer nature, charming cute angle
data.mood: 天真烂漫、古灵精怪与神明少女的夏日欢歌
data.description: 远离山下暑气，深山溪水冰爽沁骨。身为神刀之灵的丛雨将小脚丫伸进哗哗流淌的溪水里，激起一串串晶亮的水珠，金黄双髻上的朱红发带欢快摇晃。她兴奋地晃着小腿，回过头向桥头的人大声招手——「吾之主人！快过来快过来！这里的溪水好凉快呀！丛雨的脚丫都要被小鱼啄痒啦，快下来陪丛雨一起踩水嘛！」
data.promptProse: Murasame kicks her feet excitedly in a cold mountain stream while perched on a red wooden bridge in her shrine-maiden swimdress, laughing happily under the morning forest canopy. Morning mountain sunlight filters through the forest canopy in shimmering dappled patterns, casting playful sparkling reflections off the rushing river rapids.
data.animaCaption: Morning mountain mist parts over the babbling brook as the spirit blade maiden revels in icy cold waters. Morning mountain sunlight filters through the forest canopy in shimmering dappled patterns, casting playful sparkling reflections off the rushing river rapids.
